subject.title: fix(signal): preserve newlines in debounced messages

question: Should this protected Signal delivery change require a redacted live receive transcript or bridge log before merge, rather than relying solely on the focused mocked inbound-context test?
rationale: The branch changes user-visible message content, while the supplied PR evidence expressly excludes a real Signal send/receive run; repository policy treats real behavior proof as a merge gate for external PRs.

options.title: Require live Signal proof
options.body: Request a redacted after-fix Signal receive transcript, bridge log, or terminal capture showing two debounced messages arrive as separate lines.

options.title: Accept focused test proof
options.body: An owner may explicitly accept the focused assertions and existing checks as sufficient for this narrow formatting correction.

recommendation.title: Require live Signal proof
